Details of the field value set by the user for the particular label.
{
"id": string,
"title": string,
"fieldValues": [
{
object (FieldValue (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#FieldValue))
}
],
"reason": {
object (Reason (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Reason))
}
}
JSON representation
Fields
id
string
Identifier of the field
displayName
string
Display name of the field
type
string
Type of the field
reason
object (Reason
(/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Reason))
The reason why the field was applied to the label.
Union field value. Stores the values stored in the field value can be only one of the following:
{
"id": string,
"displayName": string,
"type": string,
"reason": {
object (Reason (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Reason))
},
// Union field value can be only one of the following:
"unsetValue": boolean,
"longTextValue": string,
"textValue": string,
"textListValue": {
object (TextListValue (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#TextListValu
},
"selectionValue": {

},
"selectionListValue": {
object (SelectionListValue (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Selec
},
"integerValue": string,
"userValue": {
object (UserValue (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#UserValue))
},
"userListValue": {
object (UserListValue (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#UserListValu
},
"dateValue": {
object (Date (/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Date))
}
// End of list of possible types for union field value.
}
Fields
unsetValue
boolean
If the field is unset, this will be true.
longTextValue
string
Setting a long text value.
textValue
string
Setting a text value.

object (TextListValue
(/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#TextListValue))
Setting a text list value.
selectionValue
object (SelectionValue

object (SelectionListValue

)

format)
Setting an integer value.

(/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#UserValue))
